vehicles.name: The Road Manor
vehicles.lore: A 1982 family motorhome, beige with a brown and orange stripe. Someone welded boiler plate over the nose, put steel mesh over the windows, cut a gun hatch in the roof and kept the lace curtains. The ice box still works.

vehicles.name: Salt-Crusted Pickup
vehicles.lore: A farm pickup that sat in the salt to its axles for a decade. The frame is fine. Everything else squeaks.
